> **Beta of this fork** of [iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy](https://github.com/iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy), built on upstream **2.0.6**. Samsung packages: Tizen 6.5–7 (`NuvioTpk65`) and Tizen 8–9 (`NuvioTpk`). It is a pre-release, so installed apps do not auto-update to it: install the `.tpk` by hand (Apps2Samsung).

## Player
- Tapping Left/Right pauses the picture right away and starts loading the target as soon as you stop tapping, so the jump lands faster. Back still returns to where you were.
- The time label jumps straight to the target instead of counting through every second.
- Sources whose add-on asks for extra headers (Referer, Origin) now play on the TV too. Before, they worked on the phone and failed on Samsung.
- Embedded ASS subtitles no longer disappear for a while when the download falls behind: the TV's own subtitle track fills the gap and the app takes over again once it catches up.

## Sources
- New **Quality** filter next to MP4, Cached and Dubbed. Each press cycles 4K → 1080p → off.

## Settings
- About and help › Log › **Send log to**: choose the Nuvio service or a Mac on your local network. With the Mac option, "Send log" goes straight to the receiver on your home computer (`tools/receptor-log.py`), no account needed.
